home.title: When the response disappears, what do you know?
home.lead: Real distributed failures make ordinary code hard to judge. Follow the evidence, test the contract, and see which next action the property permits.
home.question: Would you send it again?
home.answerNote: You chose “{answer}.” Keep that thought; the observation alone does not settle the decision.
home.cta: See what the caller actually knows
home.method: Evidence tells you what happened locally. The contract tells you what the other side may still do. The property tells you what must remain true.
about.title: The six questions
about.lead: FaultScope teaches you to reason from evidence, contract, and property before choosing a repair. Use these questions on ambiguous production failures.
about.tail: A pattern name is not an answer. The contract determines which actions are justified by the evidence.
